body:
Hi — I’m testing a small evidence-report workflow for open-source maintainers, and AgentPilot looks like a strong fit for one bounded trial.

The trial would use only one public GitHub repository at one fixed public commit, run once, and be free of charge. I would not request private code, credentials, customer data, repository access, code changes, posting rights, payment, or any commercial commitment.

A reply would only indicate interest. No analysis would begin until you review a separate one-page scope and consent form. Any draft report would remain private unless you separately approve sharing, and you could decline or withdraw at any time.

Would you be open to receiving the one-page scope?
disclosures: one public repository at one fixed public commit
no repository access or code changes
reply is not consent and does not start analysis
separate scope and written consent required
decline or withdraw at any time
